scenarios.name: recovery_supersedes_interactions
scenarios.note: Three interactions follow the inception. A rotation at the second interaction's number, following the first and signed with the committed next key, supersedes the second and third; the log continues from it, and the superseded interactions offered again are likely duplicitous.

scenarios.name: recovery_of_the_first_interaction
scenarios.note: A rotation at number one, following the inception, supersedes the interaction accepted there.

scenarios.name: recovery_with_the_wrong_prior
scenarios.note: A rotation at number two names the interaction it would supersede as its prior, instead of the event before it, and is refused.

scenarios.name: recovery_keeps_the_witnesses
scenarios.note: A witnessed recovery rotation cuts one witness and adds another. keripy derives no witness changes for a rotation at or below the latest number, so the witnesses stay as they were and the rotation is witnessed by a current one.
